events.text:
This request is for a holder for petrol (fuel), which I can't safely build as asked.

**Why:** The Hex Cluster parts are 3D-printed plastic and the configurator only checks that parts fit together — it does not verify material strength, fuel resistance, leak containment, ventilation, crash safety, or fire safety. A printed caddy cannot be relied on to hold heavy, sloshing jerry cans upright in a moving car boot, or to contain petrol vapours or spills. Building it as described would create a serious fire and health risk.

**What I can build instead:**
* A general-purpose workshop caddy / boot organizer for cold, non-flammable items — tools, cleaning supplies, bottles of water, etc. — with bins, dividers and tie-down points
* A stationary storage rack for empty, properly-vented fuel containers in a ventilated outbuilding (not in a vehicle) — but even then only as a shape guide, not as a certified fuel store

If you want one of those safe alternatives, tell me the size of the items and the boot space and I will configure it.
Safe alternative requested — I'll configure a general-purpose workshop caddy for your boot.
